sections: On the local device
Enter maintenance → Feeding paused → Refill / clean → Reassemble → Readiness check → Explicit resume.
Protection
No unexpected dispensing during the declared safe procedure. This App page is guidance, not a remote pause/resume controller.
Meal due during maintenance
Show Not executed only if evidence supports it; otherwise Unconfirmed. Late-meal/catch-up policy remains unresolved. Do not automatically dispense extra food.
App is optional
Local schedule, local edit, manual-feed review, status check and maintenance remain accessible under declared powered/valid conditions.
Local configuration
Set/check time → Draft meal → Review → Save locally → Inspect active plan. No registration/pairing prerequisite.
Manual feed boundary
Review intended portion and upcoming scheduled meal. Policy unresolved / design decision required near a scheduled meal. No automatic skip, double feed or retry.
Hardware concept
Abstract interaction roles only, not final industrial design. No screen size, display technology, specific buttons or sensor capability selected.
